Night is a material.

A note on Collection 004

We dress for the hour when the city empties and its hard edges soften. After Hours studies the uniform as shelter: dense fleece, articulated nylon, sculpted rubber and small objects made for leaving unnoticed. Nothing shouts. Every piece earns its silhouette in motion.

“Designed for the space between departure and arrival.”

Field notes

Look 01 — Sublevel, 02:17

A

The room holds its breath.

Nocturne Hood over Relay Cargo. Washed black layers absorb the architecture; matte hardware returns only a trace of light.

B

Movement without announcement.

Volumes are cut wide, then drawn inward at cuff and ankle. A silhouette designed to shift, never settle.

C

Utility after midnight.

Pockets become structure. Fastenings become punctuation. Each detail appears only when needed.
